title: Proof of Magician
tagline: Proof of Magician DAO proves who is a magician and who is just faking it on Tiktok.
description: Real magicians (skilled meditators) are able to shift random number generators. This project is an experiment in seeing if this ability can be measured, and if it can be measured, what kinds of applications this could be used for. If you knew your healer were a blockchain-certified miracle-worker who could change the colors of pixels with her mind - what kind of world could we create?
how_its_made: This project used Aragon, Vercel, IPFS, Minty to mint NFTs to IPFS, and Unlock Protocol. We used a random number generator to create random colors and screenrecorded in order to test ability to manifest a matching color from the random number generator, on demand, and recorded it as proof to create as a video NFT on the blockchain on IPFS.
